rules.rationale: This proof-only normalization asserts a fact about the existing Map update operation: deleting the known key 1 from a disjoint binding-plus-remainder map yields the remainder. It introduces no named definition and is not separately proved in prove.sh, so it is a trusted domain fact.
This equation macro-expands the named intersectionBody proof term into the exact MPY statement sequence used for the implementation.
This equation macro-expands the named divisorBody proof term into the MPY conditional used for one trial-divisor iteration.
This equation defines the named answer value yesV as the MPY ASCII string value for YES.
This equation defines the named answer value noV as the MPY ASCII string value for NO.
This is the terminal-success equation in the recursive definition of primeFrom: no candidate divisor remains once D is at least N.
This is the terminal-composite equation in the recursive definition of primeFrom when the current candidate divides N.
This recurrence defines primeFrom on a non-dividing candidate by advancing from D to D + 1.
This equation defines primeResult for non-prime lengths N less than or equal to 1.
This equation defines primeResult for N greater than 1 by starting the primeFrom divisor recurrence at 2.
This equation defines the named mathematical summary overlapLength as the minimum right endpoint minus the maximum left endpoint.

The same loop summary is first proved by the loop-correct claim against VERIFICATION-BASE, which lacks this rule; prove.sh then compiles VERIFICATION, where the proved summary is installed for the end-to-end proof. The rule expands divisorBody and alpha-renames unused frame variables but otherwise matches the proved claim.
